title: v0.6.1 git-root-in-subdir fix
desiredOutcome: The orchestrator works when the git repo lives in a subdirectory of the project dir — it routes git/gates through meta.gitRoot, and preflights (stops with guidance) instead of failing silently four ways. Found by end-to-end testing against a real Nx monorepo.
summary: The one structural bug the real-repo test surfaced: project dir != git root. Fixed with meta.gitRoot (+ config gitRoot + workspaceRoot fallback), a preflight that stops cleanly, and gitRoot-aware guard-bash-writes. Verified on the real Nx monorepo: existing 0.2.0 manifest now resolves gitRoot from its workspaceRoot and the preflight passes. 185 selftest cases.

tasks.title: meta.gitRoot + preflight + git -C gitRoot routing
tasks.description: Project dir != git root broke git ops, manifest commit, and guard-bash-writes silently. Add meta.gitRoot (schema+config, default '.'), audit.md preflight (git -C gitRoot rev-parse; STOP with guidance else) + git-root routing + staging strip, init.md git-root detection, workspaceRoot fallback, gitRoot-aware guard-bash-writes.

add: guard-bash-writes h1: nested gitRoot fires with project-relative path

outcome.technical: Verified against the real Nx monorepo (git in test/): fallback resolves gitRoot from workspaceRoot, preflight passes; wrong gitRoot stops; bash-write guard fires. Commit rides the release.
outcome.descriptive: The one real bug the live test found is fixed and re-tested.

tasks.title: Silence 0.2.0-manifest validator warnings
tasks.description: A 0.2.0-generated manifest threw 21 warnings under 0.6.0 (phase.description, task.details, meta.notes/workspaceRoot/baseCommit). Add phase.description as a real schema field; tolerate the rest as known keys.

outcome.technical: KNOWN_* sets extended; phase.description in schema.
